text: APPROVE: `Read` now holds only the loop and a single if/else, so its complexity is well under 15, the logic is moved over unchanged (the `continue` becomes an if/else and `i + 1` is passed as `lineNumber`), and the nullable flow on `state.*` fields is the same as on the old locals, so I see no new warnings. I reviewed the diff only and did not run the build.
